correctness.rationale: For a right cylinder B×[−H/2,H/2], the unoriented affine-plane normal may use c∈[0,1] uniform and phi uniform. The two base-hit offset intervals each have length a=w(phi)√(1−c²), separated by b=Hc; their overlap and outer convex hull give exactly ell0=(b−a)+, ell1=2min(a,b), ell2=(a−b)+ and total a+b. Integrating c gives ell0-integral H/2−w atan(H/w)/2, ell1 w atan(H/w), ell2 πw/4−w atan(H/w)/2, and Cauchy mean width gives denominator H/2+L/4. Strict f_H(w)=−2H³/(H²+w²)² and Jensen classify all and only constant-width maximizers, with stated variance-deficit bounds. One-variable g(x)=4atan x/(2x+π) has strictly decreasing derivative-numerator q(x), unique critical x* and exact peak 2/(1+x*²). Independently integrated offset intervals over c and phi for disk and rectangle-like width at three heights; six numerical checks agree to <2e−11.
residual_risks: Bounded independent calculations are not substitutes for all quantified analytical steps; no formal proof or external attestation is asserted.
